measurement.boundary: In-process GraphQL plus SQL capture and JSON encode/decode/hash; fixture creation and indexing excluded.
measurement.cold: Clear configured Django cache aliases before every sample; Python/schema/OS/SQLite already initialized.
measurement.warm: Clear cache aliases once, one untimed warmup, five repeats per process.
measurement.uncertainty: Inclusive IQR and min/max describe observed dispersion, not a confidence interval. Two processes are diagnostic evidence.
measurement.limitations: SQLite memory, no HTTP/session middleware, browser, network, PostgreSQL, production search service or concurrent load.

scope.freshness: Per user clarification, index maintenance owns freshness. Runtime source/field/relation permission checks remain.
scope.other_release_gates: Original calendar/1000-booking gates were not rerun; their existing origin/main failures remain separate.
